name: Exp_i-KlPrice_Vol
summary: This EA is based on the i-KlPrice_Vol indicator, which combines Kluge Price analysis with volume filtering to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the indicator shows bullish momentum confirmed by volume and enters short positions on bearish momentum with volume confirmation. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, executing trades based on indicator crossover signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i-KlPrice_Vol指标，该指标结合了Kluge Price分析与成交量过滤来生成交易信号。当指标显示由成交量确认的看涨动量时建立多头头寸，在由成交量确认的看跌动量时建立空头头寸。EA系统化运行，无需手动干预，根据指标交叉信号执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于i-KlPrice_Vol指标，该指标将价格动量（KlPrice）与成交量（Volume）相结合，形成复合信号。入场条件为：当KlPrice指标上穿零线且成交量放大时做多，当KlPrice指标下穿零线且成交量放大时做空。出场条件依赖于指标反向交叉信号或固定止损/止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于可用保证金的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA没有采用马丁格尔或网格策略，而是基于信号的单向交易模式。整体而言，该策略属于动量跟踪类型，利用价格变化率与成交量的共振来确认趋势方向。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the i-KlPrice_Vol indicator, which combines price momentum (KlPrice) with volume filtering to form composite signals. Entry conditions are: go long when the KlPrice indicator crosses above the zero line with increasing volume, and go short when it crosses below the zero line with increasing volume. Exit conditions rely on indicator reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on available margin. Money management does not employ martingale or grid strategies, instead relying on signal-based directional trading. Overall, the strategy falls into the momentum-following category, leveraging the resonance of price rate-of-change and volume to confirm trend direction.
pros: 结合价格动量与成交量确认，信号可靠性较高
采用固定止损止盈，风险可控
策略逻辑清晰，无马丁格尔或网格等高风险策略
成交量过滤减少了虚假信号的产生
参数可调性强，适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Combines price momentum with volume confirmation for higher signal reliability
Uses fixed stop-loss and take-profit, keeping risk controllable
Clear strategy logic without high-risk martingale or grid approaches
Volume filtering reduces false signal generation
Highly adjustable parameters to adapt to different market conditions
cons: 成交量数据在MT5中可能不够精确，影响信号质量
缺乏多重时间框架确认，可能在逆势中频繁开仓
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同行情下效果差异大
无交易时段过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不良信号
单一指标策略，缺乏多维度市场分析
cons_en: Volume data in MT5 may not be precise enough, affecting signal quality
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, may frequently open positions against the trend
Fixed SL/TP doesn't account for market volatility (ATR), leading to varying results across different market conditions
No trading session filter, potentially generating poor signals during low liquidity periods
Single indicator strategy lacking multi-dimensional market analysis
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性调整出场点
加入多时间框架确认机制，提高信号有效性
增加交易时段过滤，避免低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit, adjusting exit points based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to improve signal validity
Add trading session filter to avoid trading during low liquidity periods

risk_points: 固定止损未考虑市场波动性，可能在剧烈行情中止损过小或过大
无交易时段过滤，低流动性时段滑点风险增加
成交量数据在MT5中的精确度有限，可能导致错误信号
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss doesn't account for market volatility, potentially too small or too large during volatile moves
No session filter increases slippage risk during low liquidity periods
Volume data precision in MT5 is limited, potentially causing false signals
